function.name: read_sap_object
function.description: Fetch and display the source code of an existing SAP object (PROGRAM, CLASS, METHOD, FUNCTION MODULE, etc.). Use this to read, analyze, or examine existing code before making changes.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to read

object_name.description: Technical name of the object (e.g., 'ZCL_TEST', 'ZCL_TEST=>METHOD_NAME', 'Z_PROGRAM'). Supports a wildcard pattern to list matching objects (e.g. 'ZCL_AITOOL_*') and a comma-separated list to read several objects in one call

reason.description: Why this read is needed (for logging/context)

function.name: modify_sap_object
function.description: Create or modify source code of an SAP object. Provide the complete new source code or modifications. This tool handles SAVE operations for classes, programs, methods, function modules, etc.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to modify or create

source_code.description: The complete source code to save/write to the object

is_new_object.description: Set to true if creating a new object, false if modifying existing

description.description: Brief description of what was changed/created

function.name: review_sap_object
function.description: Perform code review, quality analysis, bug detection, or inspection of an existing SAP object. Must be preceded by a read_sap_object call for the same object.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to review

focus_areas.description: Which aspects to focus on in the review

function.name: delete_sap_object
function.description: Delete an entire SAP object (CLASS or PROGRAM). WARNING: This operation is permanent. Only use when explicitly requested.

object_type.description: Type of object to delete (only PROG or CLAS)

object_name.description: Technical name of the object to delete

reason.description: Why this object should be deleted

confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm deletion

function.name: search_sap_objects
function.description: Search for SAP objects by pattern, type, or name. Useful for finding existing objects or analyzing the codebase.

search_pattern.description: Pattern to search for (wildcard: *, can use % or _)

object_types.description: Which object types to search in

package_name.description: Optional: restrict search to specific SAP package

function.name: analyze_dependencies
function.description: Analyze calls, references, and dependencies between SAP objects. Shows what calls what and impact analysis.

analysis_type.description: What kind of dependency analysis to perform
